To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the learning organization is not a fad, but a way of life.

the learning organization is a new paradigm of organizational learning, and it is a process of organizational transformation, and it is an organizational change process, which requires new roles, new skills, new attitudes, and new values.

the learning organization is an organizational culture that is based on a learning organization philosophy that includes a learning organization theory and a learning organization strategy, all three of which must be in place for a learning organization to function effectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the learning organization, the learning community, and the learning individual.
the following question: how can organizations be transformed into learning organizations?
how to create a learning organization that will be able to adapt to the new global environment and to create a learning society in the new global economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a Learning Organization is one in which people continually expand their capacity to create the results they truly desire, where new and expansive patterns of thinking are nurtured, where collective aspiration is set free, and where people are continually learning to see the whole together.
the learning organization should not only include all aspects of the organization but should also include all levels and types of learning.

a learning organization is a system of continuous learning, where learning and change are the norm, and where learning and change is the focus, and where learning, change, and innovation are the goals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to demonstrate that the four quadruple feedback loops are necessary for learning organizations.
we have found the most important role in learning organizations is that of ethical leadership.
the most effective way to develop knowledge in an organization is to develop a learning organization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the learning organization should not only be a learning organization, but also a learning community.
learning is a process that is not limited to the classroom or to a single individual.
the learning organization is not just about learning, but about re-organizing to increase the learning capacity of all people.
